about:
AutoTecknic USA is based in Rosemead, California. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It operates as a manufacturer of carbon fiber components for luxury performance vehicles.

The company produces carbon fiber composite upgrades including aero parts, steering wheel trims, shift paddles, mirror covers, engine covers, and interior trim pieces. It also fabricates carbon fiber lifestyle accessories such as smartphone cases, wallets, and cardholders. Manufacturing processes involve aerospace-grade pre-preg carbon fiber layup and CNC machining of 6061-T6 billet aluminum. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

AutoTecknic serves the automotive aftermarket, focusing on owners of BMW, Porsche, Audi, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Mercedes-Benz, Nissan, and Toyota Supra models. Its product catalog lists direct-fit replacements for specific OEM part numbers across dozens of vehicle chassis codes. The company also partners with aftermarket brands including Acexxon, Active Autowerke, AMS Performance, and others.

AutoTecknic states its aim is to increase aerodynamic performance, vehicle stability, and aesthetic appeal through cutting-edge design and skilled craftsmanship. It backs products with a one-year warranty against defects in materials and workmanship under its ISO 9001 quality certification.
